comments_fixed: Marco provided clear information on how to get to the flat and how to use everything. He also responded quickly to any questions I had during my stay. The flat was exactly as advertised. Very clean and tidy and all the facilities that I needed. Location was good. I was working in Canary Wharf and the flat is less than 10 minutes walk from Canada Water tube station. Tesco supermarket just around the corner.

Tim had great communication and direction to let ourselves into the flat which we appreciated. The area of Camden is a gritting London neighbourhood which is what we wanted. The Market which is a 5 minute walk is on daily and you could really spend hours there. We felt safe with our two kids there and walking to and from the tube was easy. Having the large grocery store right on the way was also handy.

The apartment was really nice. Comfortable, clean and quiet. The neighbourhood is residential, nice if you want to relax, only 1 block from Thames riverside. It's not very near from the underground. It's takes some time to go to central London, mostly at night. If you want to go to pubs, theatre and nightlife in general it's not the correct place. Nice to go with family and relax

Communication with Olga was good and the apartment is like in the pictures. Location is great. Just 5 minute walk from West Kensington Tube with shops, restaurants, a pub and Tesco express juts minutes away. Olga was friendly and also invited me to go with her to a huge park she frequents which was full of deer and a nice gesture from her. The apartment was clean and a good spot for a short stay in London.

Tracy was great! Extremely Responsieve and helpful throughout the booking prices. The flat is lovely, and conveniently located close to the subway, from which can you can easily reach all attractions in London. Would highly recommend staying at this place!

Lovely little apartment! Very modern, clean, with all the comforts needed for a superb stay! Excellent location, in a very quiet neighborhood, very close to the overground or to Jubilee line subway. Marc is a great host, prompt to respond. Will definitely return.

Rosie's flat was absolutely lovely! It had everything I needed for my stay (was exactly as pictured) and it is situated in a lovely part of London! Rosie was very helpful, providing great information on the flat and the area. She made sure that I had everything I needed and always responded quickly to emails. Thank you Rosie for having me stay at your flat!

Rania was lovely to deal with. Her place is beautiful and in an ideal location close to transport and shopping. I had some technical issues with my airbnb account and Rania and her husband were extremely understanding! She was always polite and a pleasure to deal with.
Great location, easy access to the tube (ladbroke grove station) and buses. The apartment is the perfect size and the sleeping nook was so cosy and warm. Great stay!

Tom's place is incredibly charming - his home is very clean, uniquely furnished, and well situated for getting around to other parts of London. The neighborhood is quiet and quaint, but close to all the activity that Notting Hill has to offer, so definitely take time to explore the neighborhood such as Portobello Market while venturing out to other parts of London as well. Tom thoroughly provides all the details needed, which was extremely helpful for our stay. The mezzanine bed was a cool experience, and his home receives tons of natural lighting during the day when the sun is out. Definitely recommend this place!
A great place to stay - Tracy was very welcoming and the apartment had everything we needed - superb location. Thank you!
Such a lovely spot, right between Richmond and Twickenham. Stew and Nikki were really helpful and polite.

We had a wonderful weekend staying at Carey's flat. Carey is a warm, friendly & considerate person who made us feel very welcome.The flat is extremely comfortable & spotless with thoughtful touches of fresh flowers & everything provided for a home from experience.

Amazing! The best cost effective one! We enjoy staying here. The couple are super friendly and helpful. Cozy house and delicious breakfast are memorable!Extremely recommend! I will definitely book again! Thank you so much.

Tracy is a wonderful and kind host who goes out of her way to ensure you are well provided for. Her house is quirky, cool and comfortable in a great location. She even was sweet enough to get me a birthday gift! Absolutely delightful- thanks for sharing your wonderful home with us Tracy. Sam 😊
Lydia's space is terrific, very conveniently located in an up and coming part of south London. Short walk to public transport, had no problem exploring London at all.

Isabelle has a super comfortable and stylish place in an excellent location. At her recommendation we were able to jump on and off London buses, enjoying views of London we would otherwise have missed. Isabelle's knowledge of the area is fantastic, making for a very enjoyable couple of days.
Great location to explore the city. Debby is a good host (clear instructions/communication for check in & out). The apartment has everything you need.
The place served its purpose for our stay. Easy location to get to train, store, and eating places. Very spacious where we all had our own bed and room. Easy check in. Thank you.
Fantastic location & amazing facilities. By far my favorite place to stay in London! Easy check in & check out process.

The host has created a comfortable, clean, and welcoming space in a beautiful Richmond neighborhood. Rosie's thoughtfulness extended beyond the milk, juices and snacks available on arrival. Instructions and helpful notes were clear, and her suggestions for making the most of our time were greatly appreciated. Rosie was quick to respond to any questions we had, and her help in arranging transfer to the airport helped smooth our departure. We hope to return for an extended visit in the not too distant future!

Great spot. Great location. Walking distance to vibrant streets , shopping and food. Tastefully decorated and comfortable. Would def recommend to others to stay here. Also very friendly, helpful and communicative hosts. Thank you.
Branca is a a great host, very reliable and active communication. The space is tasteful and ideally located in the heart of shoreditch.

This place is a MUST visit if you like a quirky place . There’s a little ladder to climb on top which I found absolutely Adorable! The balcony has a nice view and has a table and two chairs, we celebrated my best friend’s birthday there. The only thing missing is an oven which would make things a bit convinient but all in all it’s great! This place is 5 minute walking from the notting hill gate station and you can book a cab to anyplace you like , doesn’t charge a lot! Thank you Max and Billie for this experience and making everything worth it !

I felt right at home staying at Carey's place. She is a wonderful host. The flat is comfortable and spacious with so many extras and thoughtful touches like coffee, tea, flowers, and some basic necessities on hand. There is a lovely garden which my dog and I both loved. The The bed is so comfortable and there is more than enough space for storing your clothes. The flat is in a very convenient location close to transportation and a supermarket and coffee shop right down the street. I highly recommend Carey's place for your visit to London.
Stunning place and very clean, hosts were very easy to communicate with and would definitely want to come again! Great location.
A great location (for work purposes). The property was clean, well equipped and very comfortable. Off-road parking is a bonus. Would recommend Bipin's place.

It's very clean and nice (just like in pictures). Everyone is friendly and helpful. Location is also good. I really can't think about any negative aspect and can only recommend to give this place a try.

This apartment is ideally located for exploring London with a fair degree of attractions walkable. It is also very close to the tube so it's easy to get about. It's a nice neighbourhood and the street is quieter than you may expect in central London. The apartment itself is well appointed and comfortable. Nick was an excellent host with friendly, clear and precise communications and provided advice and flexibility when we needed it. I would definitely stay here again if I return to London.

Overall, it was as expected & pretty good value for the price. When I got there, I messaged because there were no towels and got a response within an hour or two and I was able to get some. Then around 10pm I messaged again because I was getting ready for bed and noticed there were no sheets on the bed. I stayed up for awhile waiting on a response but did not get one until later the next morning. The host said that what was on the bed was their “sheets” but it had the texture and appearance of a mattress cover and by all accounts looked like one based on ones I’ve seen before. It was not a traditional sheet set with a fitted & top sheet and definitely didn’t feel like sheets either, so that’s something to know if you’re planning on booking!
A great little place - very clean and modern, has all the amenities you need and only 5 mins walk from the local station. Very easy checkin and a most welcoming host! Thank you Bipin!
Great apartment in the perfect location. Lisa was great. Good communication and if we needed anything she was there. Enjoyed our stay immensely. Would come back again.

The apartment was great - very comfortable, modern and clean. It was walking distance to where we were going (20-30 min). Wifi was slow but a high speed service was installed as we left. Host team were very responsive.

location is very convenient. You can either take central line/ Hammersmith and City line to central London. Room is very clean and you will be able to use the kitchen and washing machine. Host is very responsive. I will definitely revisit if I come back to London.
Great host, the place was clean and was at a good location! Didn’t disappoint! Loved my stay
Everything was fine, very close to Notting Hill Gate Underground, we‘ve had a nice stay in London! No problems at all.

We had a great stay at Matthew and Annabelle’s place. They were always very responsive whenever we needed something. We had a small issue and they solved it right away to make sure we had the perfect stay. The location is really great, quite central and close to the underground for a direct access to both the train station and the airport. The apartment was as shown in the pictures: clean, modern enough and with everything you would expect to find in an air BnB. Overall the apartment is great value for money compared to other listings I saw while looking for a place to stay. I would definitely recommend Matthew and Annabelle’s place for anyone looking for a lovely home away from home while in London.

Houst’s place is very decent with lovely wall paintings that accentuated the beauty of the living room. I also found Houst to be very responsive whenever I had questions. I did have a small problem with the wifi as the signal wasn’t strong in the bedroom but other than that, it was a fantastic stay.
The flat was open, spacious and clean and had a lot of amenities. It was near a supermarket, a bus stop and overground, so getting to and from central London was easy.
Ali has been helpful. He helped me to carry suitcase up to the stairs. The flat is clean and tidy and I had a wonderful stay . Thanks Ali for warm hospitality.
James was such a wonderful host! He dealt with my excessive requests with a smile and was so helpful in whatever I needed! Highly recommend this stay.

Very clean and convenient to Underground stations. Easily walkable neighborhood with lots of food and beverage choices. Small grocery right up the street to get supplies for our stay.) Paolo was very responsive and quick to respond to questions. George the Concierge was very helpful, friendly, and accommodating. He gave us lots of great recommendations.
Can’t say enough about Jennifer’s place. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four. Loved everything about the flat and the neighborhood. Will definitely try to go back again!

Kristy's place was great and she was a wonderful communicator, both at checkin and with questions during the stay. The bus stop right outside was very convenient as well. Perfect for the 4 of us for 2 weeks!

Great flat in a quiet residential street within easy walking distance of Tooting High Srreet and the Underground. It was clean and comfortable and ideal for our weekend exploring the local area. We will definitely look to stay again.

Evelyn’s place was exactly what I needed for my solo strip to London for a week. Her directions to/instructions for the place were detailed and accurate. She was immediately responsive in all communication. Her home is situated in a lovely quiet neighborhood in northeast London, very close to the tube station. My room and ensuite bathroom was exquisitely clean -seemed almost brand new! The bed was super comfy (sheets were immaculate & crisp!) Good value for the money - I had a great stay!

Great place to stay, wonderful communication with hosts, and very close to the transportation to the city. We loved it there, it was very nice room, everything was clean and tidy, which is very much appreciated. We would definitely come back in a future opportunity!

A cosy stay in a great location, a stone's throw from the main street meaning plenty of excellent restaurants and public transport all around. A little noisy on a Friday night, but nothing unusual for how close the place is to everything!
Very clean and fantastic hosts always checking in. Close to transport links to get into london .

George was actually who we dealt with, and he was friendly and accommodating and very responsive. The flat is a small but charming spot near SoHo, very quiet but within walking distance to tons of things, including a ton of restaurants, coffee shops, the West End and even Buckingham Palace. Excellent place to take in how wonderful London is!
Had a wonderful stay at Van’s place, the apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfy. I recommend!

Sandra’s place was lovely and had everything you need for a great London stay. The home was clean and well-organized and the 24/7 security gives you confidence. Nordine (co-host) was very helpful and flexible for early arrival; he was also very personable and gave the London run-down for things to do. The flat location is accessible to almost everything; I used Sandra’s guide daily for cafes and restaurants! I definitely recommend this stay

You get what the advert promises. A small but practical apartment, ideal for short stays for one person or a couple. Quiet and peaceful, no noise disturbances during my stay. Comfortable bed with clean linen. Transport is quite ideal, with easy access to the city centre and sights by bus and metro. Shop, restaurants are available nearby. Self check in is very easy and convenient.

Nada was an absolutely stunning host. She makes us feel like home. Very well communicated with the train station and restaurants. The house is beautiful and stunning. You have all the little snacks and treats for yourself, really nice and much appreciated. We will recommended this home and Nada 200%!

We had a good time, and were very kindly hosted by Ruth. The apartment was clean and generally well equipped. It's good to know that there is no dining table or any chairs in the kitchen-living room. London was very cold during our stay, and the pre-programmed heating system made it somewhat difficult to keep the house warm.
Great location for easy access to the tubes. Plenty of space for the entire family to relax and play pool or watch a show. Having a washing machine and dryer was very helpful. Highly recommend!

Sanya is a very nice and helpful host. The location of the stay is excellent, although the building itself is quite old and traditional style and located in the heart of Soho. If you enjoy London's nightlife and surrounding with a lot of shops, you will find the location convenient.

Beautiful home and great communication from host. Home just as beautiful as in the pictures. Bus stop just outside and tube station around a 10 min walk. Views of the Shard from window. Lidl very close so great for little bits and bobs. Easy to access as Shlome provided clear instructions. Would recommend and come back!
A great place to stay! Spacious flat, with many wonderful amenities. Loved the balcony! Would stay here again!
Our stay was unforgetable. The location was amazing close to everyything ,metro was 1 min away and Simon was so helpful whatever we needed was there for us immediately.

We loved our stay! Beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to paddington station and Hyde park. Also easy access to bikes. The home was very big - three queen sized beds and 2.5 baths. All On one floor (below grade). I would recommend this flat for a group or family! Thank you Gordana for being so welcoming and helpful!

Recently stayed at Michael's place. Location was perfect for our weekend visit to London and for attending a sporting event at London Stadium. 15 min walk to train and to stadium. Michael was very responsive to questions and provided great info re: train travel from airport and location of closest grocery store etc. Looks exactly as pictured. Would highly recommend
Amazing place and loved the location. Highly recommended for anyone looking to stay in the heart of Lodon

Jadin is a friendly host and made sure all the logistics of the stay were seamless. The room itself is a great base for which to explore London, particularly because of the flat’s proximity to public transport. Everything was clean and tidy and Jadin also provided complementary bottled water, which was a nice touch.

The apartment is super clean and modern, located on a safe residential street with plenty of shops and amenities. I especially loved the kitchen and bathroom. The best part of the experience was the host, who was very understanding and helpful. I will definitely come back when I need to visit central London. Thank you!😊
Wonderful stay! It was a little smaller than expected but overall great location, very walkable to stores and restaurants!
The accommodation is very good in a pleasant neighbourhood. We were well received. I highly recommend it!
The location was really convenient, near lots of food options and the Underground. Despite being on a very busy street, the apartment was quiet and sleeping was not affected.

I took a leap of faith to use an Air B N B internationally. The place and host were so great, helpful and the location made me feel part of UK. I walked everywhere and it was easy to navigate. The place was peaceful, quiet and amazing. I hope to return next year!
Beautiful apartment in the center of notting hill! highly recommended. Usman is an exceptional person and very helpful!

Place was fabulous! Perfect for our party of 6. Conveniently located to transportation, grocery and pubs. Short train/tube ride to all of London's attractions. Hosts were super responsive to any questions we had. Hosts also provided one of the most comprehensive Guidebook. Would definitely rent again. Thank you Anton and Kevin.

Thank you for a wonderful stay!! we had a very comfortable and easygoing time. Michael and kelli were very friendly and gave clear easy instructions, we had everything we needed and the flat is a very clean and cosy space. it was great to be able to have the back doors open onto the garden. easy transport links right outside the door and easy to walk to nearby shops! Thank you so much!
Thank you Adam for your flexibility in check in, the nice touches you included when we arrived, and overall a nice experience in London!

My wife and I visited Richmond/London to enjoy the history, beauty, and walkability. This was the perfect place. Rosie was an awesome host. She was easy to communicate with, had great recommendations, and the place was perfect for our needs. We will be back, and will definitely stay here again. Highly recommend it!

Great stay, easy check in. George, who greeted us at the property, was very helpful during the check in process and gave us all the information we needed. Paolo responded to all of our questions promptly. Thank you!
We absolutely loved this place and its location! Lindi was over and above helpful for us. We cannot wait to come back and wouldn’t bother looking for anywhere else to stay!
Herman was a great host, easy to deal with and communicative. Room was clean. Bathroom and kitchen not so clean. Water in Shower not 100% functional.

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! I needed to extend my stay, and Tina accommodated me right away, which I really appreciated. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Excellent communication and a smooth experience overall. Highly recommend!
Would recommend 10/10. So homey and cosy. Laura is super helpful and friendly. The place was super clean and Laura even left us a bottle of wine. :)
Problem with the hot water. Regardless we’re good at responding to my messages but no solution was forthcoming during our stay however they organised a refund via Airbnb

Lovely, quiet & peaceful and so central for our needs. Easy to get about on foot or public transport. Comfy bed & calming ambiance, great bathroom and kitchen facilities - we loved the decor and plants, really well equipped with many extras which were much appreciated. Zuzana & Simon are friendly & helpful and quick to respond. We thoroughly recommend their place and would love to return on future visits to London.

Exceeded our expectations. we were too tired at nights, so noise soming from metro or thin walls didnt stop us getting a good sleep like some previous visitors. just a tip for future visitors, 'bounce"app provides cheap luggage storage with a location just around the corner of the airbnb. since we there was no flexibility for checkin times we have used their services , was convenient. overall perfect stay. thanks james.

We had a very pleasant stay overall. The building is modern, with great amenities and comfortable spaces for both work and relaxation. The room was stylish and well-equipped, though the layout around the bed area felt a bit cramped. The bed can be lifted to create additional space, which helped, although it would have been nice to have a table in the unit to eat/work from. All the equipment was high-end and up to date. A fan was provided but circulation wasn't great. Communication with the host was excellent, and the staff responded promptly to minor issues early on. The location is also convenient, about a 10–13 minute walk to either the Underground or Overground, with a large Sainsbury’s nearby. Would recommend as a great stay.
Great place to stay! In addition, George, whom welcomes you, is very friendly and provides many recommendations.

Excellent host ! Vey friendly, very accommodating and very helpful. It makes your stay more enjoyable and relaxed knowing your host is always there to help. Great area - walkable distance to everything.

The apartment is in a good condition, spacious and adequately equipped. It is a 15 minutes walk from the metro station which facilitated our transportation to the city centre. Olivia is very responsive. We recommend it.

We loved staying with Max & Billie! The location was in the heart of beautiful Notting Hill, just a short walk from Portobello Road and even Kensington Gardens. The flat was really cute and just like the photos. We obviously expected it to be small but having the bed set higher made it feel like a separate bedroom so you had more space downstairs. The balcony was our favourite thing about the apartment. So beautiful and such a luxury to have, just note that it is shared with the room next door. The view was also great! Max & Billie‘s communication was amazing and they always responded very quickly. Everything was perfect! Thank you! :)

The place was accurately described in the listing, and overall, it matched our expectations in terms of location. However, there were a few things we wish we had known in advance. The flat was a bit dusty and could have used a more thorough cleaning before our arrival. In fact, the bed appeared as though the sheets hadn’t been washed, as well as the towels, so we chose not to use it. Also, we didn’t realize the apartment is spread over multiple levels and requires going up some steep stairs, which might not be ideal for everyone. Additionally, there is no air conditioning only three small, inexpensive fans which didn’t do much during the warmer days. Just something to be aware of if you’re staying in the summer. Otherwise, it served its purpose for a very short stay.
The apartment is very nice. However stairwells and hallways were filthy and in disrepair. Very close to Brentford Bees football stadium.
Very good location, steps from earls court tube, quiet street, close to museums, pubs and supermarket. Very clean house. Jonas always answered quickly.

I had a great stay at Sanya’s place! The apartment was super clean, cozy, and exactly like the photos. The location was quiet, safe, and close to everything I needed. Sanya was an amazing host — she responded very quickly to all my messages, was super friendly and always made sure we had everything we needed. She even let us stay a bit longer during check-out, which we really appreciated! Highly recommend staying here. I’d definitely come back again!

We had a wonderful time and the house had great facilities and a great location. Good size rooms and bathrooms and a spacious kitchen. Easy to get a parking space which was really great and Harry provided the necessary parking permits. Harry was easy to contact and extremely proactive and helpful.

Short walk to the train station, and the main intersecting street had lots of diverse restaurants/shops. There was construction going on right next door which was very loud in the mornings and the walk to pickup the key was a longer distance than expected and uphill.
We stayed 2 night with party of 6 . Lots of space , walking distance to tube station , groceries , restaurants etc. Beds were great big bedrooms . I would stay there again

World class rental experience, Sofia was responsive and available whenever we needed her. The property was exceptional, the location was perfect, and the comfort was infinitely better than a hotel with 3 spacious bedrooms. Key exchange / check-in was a breeze.
Very close to the tube station, very lovely house, feel stay at home instead of bnb. Will come back for sure😀
Was a nice stay and the host was helpful to sort out any hiccups along the way. Was comfortable, clean and nice.
Wonderful place, best coffee place across the street. Little noisy area on the weekend but that’s not a complaint. Loved it. Would stay again. 10/10.

Great accommodation for your stay in London: -close to a big station linking you directly to other cities and neighbourhoods, -plenty of stores and restaurants right down your apartment, -the accommodation itself is fully equipped and beautifully decorated, -the room is located at the back of the building and was very quiet despite being in the middle of the animations, Zuzana is an amazing host: she is responsive, helpful and friendly. Will come back next time we come to London!
Nice stay, close to a lot of stuff whilst also being private area. Easy check in and lots of room there.
